upload.description: Upload a spreadsheet and say which catalog field each column matches.
upload.hint: CSV or TSV, up to 50 MB.
upload.helpTitle: Is your spreadsheet in another format?
upload.helpExcel: In Excel: File, Save as, and choose CSV.
upload.helpSheets: In Google Sheets: File, Download, and choose CSV.
upload.helpColumns: The first row must have the column names.

mapping.description: Choose which catalog field each column matches. Anything without a field is ignored.
mapping.noSample: No example in the first rows
mapping.noRows: The spreadsheet only has the header: there are no rows to import.
mapping.titleRequired: Choose which column is the Title: it's the only required field.
mapping.noSku: Without a code column, the first option below is what prevents duplicates when importing again.
mapping.previewTitle_one: Check: {{mapped}} of {{formatted}} column will be imported
mapping.previewTitle_other: Check: {{mapped}} of {{formatted}} columns will be imported
mapping.dedupe: Treat items with the same title as the same item
mapping.dedupeHint: A row without a code uses the title as its key: importing again updates instead of duplicating.
mapping.mirror: Copy the photos to our server
mapping.mirrorHint: Recommended for sending on WhatsApp: the photo keeps working even if the original link goes down.
mapping.cancelHint: The uploaded file and the columns you chose are discarded.

tracking.title: Import
tracking.doneWithErrorsTitle: Import completed, with rows left out
tracking.failedHint: Couldn't finish the import. Try again.
tracking.interrupted: The import was interrupted on the server. What already went in stays in the catalog: import the spreadsheet again to complete it.
tracking.abandonedHint: The file was uploaded, but the columns weren't checked. To continue, upload the spreadsheet again. If left like this, it's deleted automatically in 7 days.
tracking.canClose: You can close this panel: the import keeps going, and the progress stays on the catalog screen.
tracking.errorsHint: The row number is the same one you see in the spreadsheet.
tracking.keepGoing: Close and keep going in the background

history.emptyHint: Import a spreadsheet to create or update many items at once.
history.deleteHint: The uploaded file and the result are erased. Items that already went in stay in the catalog.

searchTest.title: Test search
searchTest.description: Write the way a customer would and see what flows find in your catalog.
searchTest.label: What the customer would write
searchTest.idle: The grid looks for words. This is the search flows use: it returns items by relevance and says how it found them.
searchTest.noMeaningHint: Search by meaning didn't take part this time: the result came only from the item's words.
searchTest.noResults: Flows wouldn't find anything with this text. Try adjusting the items' title, summary or tags.
searchTest.inactiveNote: Inactive items are left out of this search.

item.title: Title
item.summaryHint: A short sentence that introduces the item to the customer.
item.activeHint: An inactive item stays here, but flows won't find it when searching.
item.skuHint: With a code, importing the spreadsheet again updates the item instead of duplicating it.
item.tagsHint: Words that help find the item. Separate with a comma or Enter.
item.noFields: No custom fields yet. Create one to keep price, color, size: whatever your catalog needs.

errors.titleTooLong: The title can have up to {{max}} characters.
errors.summaryTooLong: The summary can have up to {{max}} characters.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a full link, like https://yourstore.com/product.
errors.tooManyTags: An item can have up to {{max}} tags.
errors.fieldInvalid: The value of {{name}} isn't valid for this field.

notFound.title: This item is no longer here
notFound.description: Someone on your team may have deleted it.

images.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to {{max}} each. The first one is the main photo.
images.newHint: Choose the photos now: they upload as soon as you create the item.
images.savedHint: The first one is the main photo, shown in the grid. Drag to change the order. JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to {{max}} each.
images.pendingHint: The photos upload as soon as you create the item. JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to {{max}} each.
images.deleteHint: It leaves the item right away. This can't be undone.
images.reorder: Photo {{position}} of {{total}}. Drag to change the order.
images.reorderFailed: Couldn't change the order of the photos. Try again.
images.invalidType: {{name}}: use JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
images.linkHint: We keep a copy of the photo, so it doesn't vanish if the link goes down.

fieldControl.optionFailed: Couldn't create the option. Try again.

categories.description: Group your items. Filtering by a category also brings what's inside it.
categories.name: Name
categories.parentHint: Leave empty for the top level.
categories.reorderFailed: Couldn't change the order. Try again.
categories.deleteHint: The items stay in the catalog, they just leave this category.
categories.deleteHintSubtree_one: The {{count}} category inside goes with it. The items stay in the catalog, they just leave these categories.
categories.deleteHintSubtree_other: The {{count}} categories inside go with it. The items stay in the catalog, they just leave these categories.

empty.title: No categories yet
empty.description: Create the first one, or import a spreadsheet: the categories in it are created automatically.

fields.pageDescription: Information specific to your catalog, like price, color or size. They show up on each item.
fields.formHint: Applies to every item in the catalog.
fields.name: Name

typeHints.text: Any text, like material or sizes.
typeHints.number: A number. Named Price, it becomes a money amount.
typeHints.list: One option among those you create, like the color.

fields.optionsHint: Separate with a comma or Enter.
fields.descriptionHint: Shows below the field, to explain what to fill in.
fields.defaultValueHint: Comes filled in when creating an item on this screen. It doesn't change existing items or apply to imports.
fields.requiredHint: Whoever creates or edits an item on this screen must fill it in. Spreadsheet imports don't check it.
fields.searchableHint: This field's value helps find the item in searches. Filtering by it works either way.
fields.key: Name used in spreadsheets and flows, which doesn't change
fields.reorderFailed: Couldn't change the order. Try again.
fields.deleteHint: It disappears from every item's screen. The values already filled in stay stored, but no longer show.

empty.title: No custom fields yet
empty.description: Create one to keep price, color, size: whatever your catalog needs.

errors.optionsRequired: A list needs at least one option.

list.search: Search by name, code or description
list.statusFailed: Couldn't change the item's status. Try again.
list.deleteHint: The item leaves the catalog along with its photos. This can't be undone.

empty.title: Your catalog is still empty
empty.description: Create the items in your catalog, one at a time or all at once with a spreadsheet.

noResults.title: No items found
noResults.withQuery: The grid looks for words. Flows can also search by meaning: see what they would find.

bulk.partial_one: {{done}} changed, but {{formatted}} item wasn't. Try again with what's still selected.
bulk.partial_other: {{done}} changed, but {{formatted}} items weren't. Try again with what's still selected.
bulk.failed: Couldn't finish the action. Try again.
bulk.deleteHint: They leave the catalog along with their photos. This can't be undone.
